blocks.tamil_translation: (just as You separate the salt water apart from the sweet water, and the sweet water apart from the salt water), I ask You to keep me far away from, and protect me from, that punishment of Jahannam on seeing which a man (will wish for death), and from the trials of the grave! O Allah! That good which my understanding cannot reach, which the strength of my deeds has fallen short of attaining, which my intention too cannot attain, that good which You have promised to any one of Your creation and which I have not asked You for until now, or which You are going to give to any one of Your slaves — I long to obtain it from You. O Lord of the worlds! I ask You for it for the sake of Your mercy! O Possessor of the firm promise! O Owner of good deeds! I ask You for freedom from fear on the Day of Punishment, and to be in Jannah with those who have attained Your nearness in the Hereafter, those present before You, those engaged in ruku and sujud, and those who fulfil Your promise. Surely You are the Most Merciful, the Most Loving; surely You do what You will. O Allah! Make us those who guide others and who are themselves rightly guided! Do not make us those who go astray or who lead astray! Make us at peace with Your friends and at enmity with Your enemies! We love those who love You, for the sake of Your love. We hold enmity, because of Your enmity, towards those of Your creation who oppose You. O Allah! Making Du'a is our task; accepting it is Your task.
